verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt exists at developer.nvidia.com, describing the NVIDIA Developer portal that hosts the CUDA Toolkit and RTX SDK docs relevant to this GPU, so an agent can be pointed at it. It is portal-wide rather than specific to the RTX 5090, and the markdown variant of the CUDA docs page returns 404. Missing for 10: product-specific agent-oriented docs, markdown/plain-text doc pages (cuda-toolkit.md 404), first-party documentation of the llms.txt contents or coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
